SAMAN Portable manufactures container offices and delivers them ready to use across Thrissur. We build each unit to order at our own ISO-certified factory and dispatch it fitted — walls, flooring, wiring, windows and doors done — to the Kinfra parks at Koratty and Athani, the Ollur belt and construction sites across the district. You deal with the maker, not a reseller or a marketplace listing. For models, sizes and finishes, see our full Container Office Manufacturer for Thrissur Kinfra Units range, then send your requirement for a quote.

A container office is a steel-framed office cabin built inside a container-style shell. Because it arrives finished, your team can move in the day it lands — no site masonry, no wet work and no long build wait. In a commercial and industrial district like Thrissur, that lets a Kinfra unit or a contractor add an admin office, a site cabin or a gate room without holding up the work.

Who buys a container office in Thrissur

Thrissur mixes a busy commercial economy with the Kinfra industrial parks at Koratty and Athani. Most of our enquiries here come from:

  • Kinfra and small-industry units needing an admin, supervisor or stores office
  • Commercial and trading firms needing a compact office beside a godown or yard
  • Construction and infrastructure contractors needing a temporary site office
  • Plots and yards needing a gate and security office at the entrance

Every unit we supply is an administrative, site or gate cabin — a clean, insulated workspace. We do not market these as process, hazardous-area or production-line structures.

Where we deliver in and around Thrissur

We supply container offices across the main working pockets of Thrissur:

  • Kinfra Small Industries Park, Koratty — 680308
  • Athani industrial side — 680581
  • Ollur industrial and commercial belt — 680306
  • Thrissur city and construction sites — 680001

These belts run on small industry, commerce and construction — buyers who often need a clean office added quickly beside a working site. Share your exact plot and gate access, and we confirm the delivery plan with the quotation.

Which container office suits your Thrissur site

Different jobs call for different cabins. As a guide:

  • A gate or single-desk security point — a 10 ft cabin
  • An admin, supervisor or stores office — a 20 ft cabin, the most common choice
  • A larger office with a meeting or record area — a 40 ft cabin, which can be partitioned
  • A Kinfra-estate plot being set up — a prefabricated container office for Kinfra estate plots

Container office sizes

SizeTypical useNotes
10 ftGate office or single supervisor cabinCompact, single door
20 ftAdmin, supervisor or stores officeMost common for estate and site use
40 ftLarge office with meeting or record areaCan be partitioned

Internal usable area and layout are confirmed at quotation, since we build to order rather than from stock.

Materials and construction

Every container office we ship to Thrissur is built to the same factory standard:

  • Structural frame in MS steel to IS 2062 grade
  • Wall and roof options in PUF sandwich panel or cement/fibre board with a GI sheet roof
  • PUF insulation to hold down heat and handle the humid Kerala climate
  • Ply-and-vinyl flooring, aluminium sliding windows, and steel or laminated doors
  • Electrical points, lighting and a distribution board wired to your layout

Exact panel thickness, wiring load and fittings are set to your spec. Anything non-standard is marked "confirm at quotation" so the price you get is honest.

Customisation options

We fit each cabin to how your site works. Common additions for Thrissur sites include AC provision, internal partitions, an attached toilet, a pantry point, extra windows, a document-storage area, company colour and branding, and an entry ramp or platform. List what you need and it goes into the quote.

Delivery from our Bangalore factory

Thrissur is served from our Bangalore factory on South-zone dispatch. The road route runs via Salem and Palakkad into Thrissur — roughly 450–490 km depending on your plot — so we suggest planning 4–5 days after the unit is built and dispatched. Default delivery is ₹3,000 where applicable; the exact freight and any crane offloading are confirmed on the quotation. Returns follow our 7-day, customer-paid return policy.

Planning across the Kerala belt? See our Kochi container office page, container offices we send down to Coimbatore, and container offices we supply toward Mangalore.

Documentation for vendor onboarding

Units and contractors in Thrissur need clean paperwork for their own audits and site entry. As a registered Private Limited manufacturer, we issue a proper GST invoice (GSTIN 29ABBCS7101B1ZR) and an e-way bill for every dispatch, and can share our ISO, NSIC and DPIIT certificate numbers for vendor registration. This keeps procurement and audit straightforward.

Why buy from SAMAN

SAMAN POS India Pvt Ltd has manufactured prefab steel structures since 2009 and has been incorporated since 2019, with 500+ projects delivered. We are certified to ISO 9001:2015 (E20250218645), ISO 14001:2015 (E20250218646) and ISO 45001:2018 (E20250218647), and registered with NSIC (NSIC/GP/BAN/2024/0055207) and DPIIT (DIPP56005). Our units carry a 5-year warranty on the structural frame and base and 1–2 years on finishing, with a 20–25 year engineered service life.

Price factors for a container office in Thrissur

We quote to your spec rather than a fixed figure, because the price moves with size (10, 20 or 40 ft), panel and insulation type, AC, electrical and plumbing fit-out, an attached toilet, quantity and the delivery distance to Thrissur. Send your requirement and we return a clear, itemised quote — no guesswork, no hidden add-ons.

Frequently asked questions

What does a container office cost in Thrissur?

There is no single fixed price. The cost depends on size (10, 20 or 40 ft), panel and insulation type, AC, electrical and toilet fit-out, quantity and the delivery distance to your Thrissur site. Share your requirement and we send an itemised quote the same way for every buyer.

Do you deliver to the Kinfra Koratty park and Ollur?

Yes. We dispatch from our Bangalore factory via Salem and Palakkad to the Kinfra Koratty park (680308), Athani (680581), the Ollur belt (680306) and Thrissur city (680001) — about 450–490 km, so we suggest planning 4–5 days. We confirm the schedule and offloading with your quote.

Which size suits a Kinfra unit or construction site office?

A 20 ft cabin covers most admin, supervisor and stores needs, a 10 ft cabin suits a gate or single-desk point, and a 40 ft cabin suits a larger office with a meeting area. Layouts are customised and confirmed at quotation.

Do you provide a GST invoice and e-way bill for vendor onboarding?

Yes. We are a GST-registered Private Limited manufacturer and issue a GST invoice and e-way bill for every dispatch, and can share our ISO, NSIC and DPIIT certificate numbers for vendor registration.

Call +91 88616 22859 or +91 80886 85440 to discuss your container office in Thrissur, or send an enquiry with your size and site details for a quote.
